chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ahmad, on the authority of Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qashany, from someone he mentioned, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim al-Ja’fari, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Hereafter is the wedding of the pious ones.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'The Hereafter is the wedding of the pious'?
ai.summary: In al-Khisal, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this concise hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), employing the cultural metaphor of 'urs' (wedding) to signify the ultimate joy and consummation of the pious' spiritual journey. This imagery underscores the Hereafter not merely as a place of reward, but as a festive union with the Divine, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the emotional and relational aspects of salvation for the muttaqin.
